newsitem.title: FRANCE: Zaire's Mobutu lands at French Riviera.
newsitem.headline: Zaire's Mobutu lands at French Riviera.

text.p: Zaire's ailing president Mobutu Sese Seko landed at the French Riviera capital of Nice from Switzerland on Monday, an airport spokesman said.
The 66-year-old Zairean president, who has a villa near Nice, had been in Switzerland since August when he underwent surgery for prostate cancer at the University Hospital in Lausanne.
Mobutu arrived aboard a private four-engined DC-8 aircraft specially designed for him and which can carry several dozen people, the spokesman said.
He made no statement on arrival and was whisked off to an undisclosed location presumed to be his personal residence in the area.

Officials in Paris said they did not know Mobutu was arriving and doubted he would meet President Jacques Chirac who is attending a Franco-Spanish summit in Marseille. That city is however relatively close to Nice.

Mobutu's arrival coincided with east Zaire falling into ever greater confusion. Fighting between rival groups has forced about a million refugees onto the roads and France has called for international action to help save them from disaster.
